title.narrative: Output 7.1. Increased capacity of Member States to ensure respect for, promote and realize fundamental principles and rights at work

description.narrative: The Ministry of Labour and Social Security (MoLSS) operationalized the National Employment Strategy of Türkiye (NES) (2014-2023), the National Programme for the Elimination of Child Labour (NPECL) (2017-2023), the Circular No. 2016/5 and the Prime Ministry Circular No. 2017/6. In full alignment with these strategies and legislations, the MoLSS made a concerted effort on the retention of the children of seasonal agricultural workers in education and to enhance the living conditions of these workers and their families. The ILO referred 11,266 children of seasonal agricultural workers to education with the support of the European Union, the Association of Chocolate, Biscuit and Confectionery Industries of Europe and Ferrero Company. Additionally, the living conditions of seasonal agricultural workers and their families were enhanced through a range of interventions such as renovation and refurbishment of 111 slums and the supply of 496 sanitation units to the gardens. Additionally, ILO conducted a training need analysis and a developed a capacity development plan for the MoLSS. Finally, ILO attended the preparatory meeting of the Specialized Commission on Children held by the Presidency of Strategy and Budget in 2022, as part of the 12th Development Plan preparations. Moreover, ILO provided inputs to the preparation of new NPECL.

description.narrative:
Türkiye participated in the 5th Global Conference on the Elimination of Child Labour in Durban on May 2022. The country submitted a formal expression of interest to become a pathfinder country to the Alliance 8.7 Secretariat through an official letter dated 19 August 2022 setting out its commitment, previous achievements, and initiatives as well as its focal point for leading and coordinating the process. Further the receipt of this letter, the Secretariat acknowledged the interest via an official letter stating that the ILO would stand ready to provide all technical support throughout the process. Throughout 2023, the Government maintained its interest to become a pathfinder country while complying the requirements for this aim and highlighted its commitment at bilateral and multinational platforms. The initiation of the Turkish Government’s taking action to become a pathfinder country was carried out with ILO’s advocacy efforts on many platforms. Namely, ILO facilitated the participation of the government representatives including the Director General (DG) of Labour with the social partners to the 5th Global Conference on the Elimination of Child Labour in Durban on May 2022. The representatives from the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy (MoLSS) and Hak-İş Confederation delivered presentations in the Good Practices Sessions and shared Türkiye’s experience and public staff from MoLSS as being the member of the Drafting Committee of “Durban Call to Action to End Child Labour” contributed to the Declaration. Following the Durban Conference, two high-level bureaucrats of MoLSS including the Deputy DG of Labour and Head of Department of Labour Policies, attended to the Alliance 8.7 Strategic Workshop in Turin in December 2022.
ILO continued to support the Government of Türkiye on its efforts to obtain the pathfinder status via projects funded by the European Union, Association of Chocolate, Biscuit and Confectionery Industries of Europe (CAOBISCO) and Ferrero Company. ILO provided substantial technical inputs to the preparations of strategic planning workshop with a whole-of-government and multi-stakeholder approach. Also, the Government re-expressed its commitment during the “12 June the World Day against Child Labour” event to the social partners and requested their involvement in the preparation of the roadmap to include the national priorities for achieving Target 8.7. Moreover, ILO is underlining Alliance 8.7 issue and Türkiye’s position with the local authorities as well as the social partners within the scope of the project activities in all platforms.
